unitTitle: Reported Speech - Reported Statements - Say/Tell - Reported Questions

pairsWith.noteUz: Ex.8 davomi, kalit so'z bilan transformatsiya, xato tuzatish, Revision 1-14 (Ex.11-12).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 14-UNIT MAShQLAR, 4-BET (70-bet, PDF 69). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '14'.

CHAP USTUN:
8) davomi: 2 SURAT: 7 barbekyu, oila va bolalar - "Do you want a hamburger?" He asked the children ...; 8 telefonda charchagan erkak - "I'm working late today." He told his wife ...
9) 'Complete each sentence with two to five words, including the word in bold.' 1 "I graduated two years ago," he told me. had - He told me he ... two years before. 2 "Why aren't you hungry?" he asked me. wasn't - He asked me why ... hungry. 3 "Mary will visit us next summer," said Ann. would - Ann said that Mary ... the following summer. 4 "She has never been to Africa," said Paul. had - Paul said that ... to Africa. 5 "Your brother is fixing the car now," Dad told me. was - Dad told me that my brother ... at the time. 6 "Dolphins are very intelligent animals," said our teacher. are - Our teacher said that dolphins ... animals. 7 "Do you like strawberries?" Susan asked me. if - Susan asked me ... strawberries. 8 "Peter invited me to his wedding," said Jack. invited - Jack said that Peter ... to his wedding.
10) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 He asked me that I had a motorcycle. ... if ... (that chizilgan). 2 Brian said me that he liked jazz music. 3 Marie asked him were the supermarket was. 4 Roy told to his father that he wanted to become a pilot. 5 Mother said us that she would be late.

O'NG USTUN:
10) davomi: 6 Jill said that she had buy a pair of jeans the week before. 7 They asked Tom weather he wanted any help. 8 Our teacher told us that the maths test would is easy.
'Revision: Units 1 - 14' (jigarrang banner):
11) 'Underline the correct word(s) in bold.' 1 Does she like go/going to the ballet? 2 Have you ever been/being sailing? 3 The plane from Bangkok arrives/arrive at 9 pm. 4 He played basketball after he had/has finished doing his homework. 5 Clive doesn't know how/why to drive. 6 Who was Romeo and Juliet written from/by? 7 Jessica used to lived/live with her parents. 8 Visitors mustn't to feed/feed the animals in the zoo. 9 Have you met your new neighbours yet/just? 10 If I had a garden I will/would plant some roses. 11 A castle is much/more bigger than a flat. 12 I went to Rome where/when I visited the Fontana di Trevi. 13 The lion is not as fast/faster as the cheetah. 14 Don't forget to take an umbrella. It will/won't rain later in the afternoon. 15 He ran quick/quickly out of the burning house.
12) 'Choose the correct answer.' 1 I can't stand ... to loud music. A to listen B listening C listen. 2 If we all ... our newspapers, fewer trees would have to be cut down. A recycled B have recycled C recycle. 3 What are these skirts ... of? A making B make C made. 4 A: When ... the Acropolis built? B: 3,000 years ago! A is B has C was. 5 How long has Mr Parker ... living here? A be B been C being.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '70'.

exercises.instructionEn: Write each statement or question in reported speech (continued). 7 'Do you want a hamburger?' He asked the children ... 8 'I'm working late today.' He told his wife ...
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir gapni ko'chirma gapda yozing (davomi). 7 'Gamburger xohlaysizlarmi?' U bolalardan ... so'radi 8 'Bugun kech ishlayman.' U xotiniga ... dedi
exercises.explanationUz:
7 SAVOL: Do you want → if they
    wanted (you → they - bolalar)
  8 DARAK: 'm working → was
    working; today → that day

  ⚠ 'work late' = kech ishlamoq.
modelAnswers: 7 He asked the children if/whether they wanted a hamburger.
8 He told his wife that he was working late that day.
modelAnswersUz: 7 U bolalardan gamburger xohlash-xohlamasliklarini so'radi. (if they wanted)
8 U xotiniga o'sha kuni kech ishlashini aytdi. (was working, that day)

exercises.instructionEn: Complete each sentence with two to five words, including the word in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Har bir gapni qalin so'zni qo'shib, ikkidan beshtagacha so'z bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT SO'Z BILAN 2-5 SO'Z.

  1 graduated → HAD graduated
  2 aren't you → I WASN'T (tasdiq
    tartib)
  3 will visit → WOULD visit them
    (us → them)
  4 has never been → she HAD never
    been
  5 is fixing → WAS fixing the car
  6 ARE very intelligent - umumiy
    haqiqat, o'zgarmaydi
  7 Do you like → IF I liked
  8 invited me → HAD invited him
    (me → him)

  ⚠ Kalit so'zni o'zgartirmang.

items.textEn: "I graduated two years ago," he told me. (had) → He told me he ___ two years before.
"Why aren't you hungry?" he asked me. (wasn't) → He asked me why ___ hungry.
"Mary will visit us next summer," said Ann. (would) → Ann said that Mary ___ the following summer.
items.whyUz: ⚠ will visit us → would visit them.

items.textEn: "She has never been to Africa," said Paul. (had) → Paul said that ___ to Africa.
items.whyUz: ⚠ has never been → had never been.

items.textEn: "Your brother is fixing the car now," Dad told me. (was) → Dad told me that my brother ___ at the time.
"Dolphins are very intelligent animals," said our teacher. (are) → Our teacher said that dolphins ___ animals.
"Do you like strawberries?" Susan asked me. (if) → Susan asked me ___ strawberries.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Do you like → if I liked.

items.textEn: "Peter invited me to his wedding," said Jack. (invited) → Jack said that Peter ___ to his wedding.

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. 1 He asked me that I had a motorcycle. → if
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni tuzating, namunadagidek. 1 He asked me that I had a motorcycle. → if
exercises.explanationUz:
XATO TUZATISh.

  1 that → IF (ha/yo'q savol)
    NAMUNA
  2 said me → TOLD me
  3 were → WHERE (savol so'zi)
  4 told to → TOLD (to yo'q)
  5 said us → TOLD us
  6 had buy → had BOUGHT (V3)
  7 weather → WHETHER (imlo:
    weather = ob-havo!)
  8 would is → would BE

  ⚠ 7-gap: 'weather' (ob-havo) va
  'whether' (-mi) bir xil
  o'qiladi, imlosi har xil.

items.textEn: He asked me that I had a motorcycle. → He asked me ___ I had a motorcycle.
Brian said me that he liked jazz music. → Brian ___ me that he liked jazz music.
Marie asked him were the supermarket was. → Marie asked him ___ the supermarket was.
Roy told to his father that he wanted to become a pilot. → Roy ___ his father that he wanted to become a pilot.
Mother said us that she would be late. → Mother ___ us that she would be late.
Jill said that she had buy a pair of jeans the week before. → Jill said that she had ___ a pair of jeans the week before.
They asked Tom weather he wanted any help. → They asked Tom ___ he wanted any help.
Our teacher told us that the maths test would is easy. → Our teacher told us that the maths test would ___ easy.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word(s) in bold.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-14 UNITLAR TAKRORI.

  1 like + -ING
  2 Have you ever BEEN sailing
  3 The plane ARRIVES (jadval)
  4 after he HAD finished
  5 know HOW to drive
  6 written BY (passiv)
  7 used to LIVE
  8 mustn't FEED (to yo'q)
  9 Have you met ... YET?
  10 If I had ..., I WOULD
  11 MUCH bigger
  12 Rome WHERE (joy)
  13 not as FAST as
  14 It WILL rain (bashorat)
  15 ran QUICKLY (ravish)

items.textEn: Does she like go/going to the ballet?
Have you ever been/being sailing?
The plane from Bangkok arrives/arrive at 9 pm.
He played basketball after he had/has finished doing his homework.
Clive doesn't know how/why to drive.
Who was Romeo and Juliet written from/by?
Jessica used to lived/live with her parents.
Visitors mustn't to feed/feed the animals in the zoo.
Have you met your new neighbours yet/just?
If I had a garden I will/would plant some roses.
A castle is much/more bigger than a flat.
I went to Rome where/when I visited the Fontana di Trevi.
The lion is not as fast/faster as the cheetah.
Don't forget to take an umbrella. It will/won't rain later in the afternoon.
He ran quick/quickly out of the burning house.

exercises.explanationUz:
1 can't stand + -ING
  2 If we all RECYCLED (2-tur)
  3 What are ... MADE of? (passiv)
  4 When WAS ... built? (o'tgan
    passiv)
  5 has ... BEEN living (present
    perfect continuous)


⚠ 'THE ACROPOLIS':

  = Afinadagi qadimiy qal'a.

items.textEn: I can't stand ___ to loud music.
If we all ___ our newspapers, fewer trees would have to be cut down.
What are these skirts ___ of?
A: When ___ the Acropolis built? B: 3,000 years ago!
How long has Mr Parker ___ living here?

patterns.formula: KIM + told + KIMGA + that ... / KIM + said + that ... (olmoshsiz)
patterns.exampleEn: Brian told me that he liked jazz music. Mother told us that she would be late.
patterns.exampleUz: Brayan menga jaz musiqasini yoqtirishini aytdi. Onam bizga kech qolishini aytdi.

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + whether / where + EGA + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: They asked Tom whether he wanted any help. Marie asked him where the supermarket was.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular Tomdan yordam kerak-kerakmasligini so'rashdi. Mari undan supermarket qayerdaligini so'radi.

patterns.formula: If + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON, EGA + would + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: If I had a garden, I would plant some roses.
